Description

Amazon Software Builder Experience (ASBX), started in 2022, is working to make Amazon the best place to build software. Every day, hundreds of thousands of Amazon software builders rely on us for the tools they build with, and for the technology, training, and community behind them. We are at an inflection point as builders shift from performing every step of software development to supervising agents that perform the steps. We own the experience that makes this transition work, empowering builders to apply their knowledge and expertise to invent more for customers.

The Role

We are seeking a Director of Software Development to lead Builder Operations (“Builder Ops”), the organization that builds the technology, tools, and services Amazon teams use to practice DevOps for all of Amazon (AWS, Retail, Devices, and beyond): incident management, change management in production, and the feedback loops that turn operational learnings into better software. This team is leading the charge to bring agentic operations to Amazon, and this leader will define how humans and agents run production together. Few engineering roles anywhere combine this scope, this scale, and this moment.

Builder Ops has built one of the largest incident-management and DevOps platforms in the industry, with the majority of that work now resolved faster, and safely, using AI. The strategic priority this leader owns is the shift to agentic operations: defining how humans and agents operate together at Amazon's safety bar, at dramatically higher speed, while maintaining the reliability builders and customers depend on. This is an established organization that owns tools and services used by virtually every builder at Amazon.

Key job responsibilities

Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for Builder Ops, connecting it to builder impact: code quality, reliability, security, developer productivity, and the shift to agent-supervised development.
Own Amazon's incident management, change management, and operational-safety capabilities across all regions.
Drive agentic operations, defining how AI agents and human operators collaborate at Amazon's safety bar at machine-speed.
Lead and grow a multi-team engineering organization: develop leaders, attract Principal Engineers, and build the leadership bench.
Drive product quality and operational excellence end to end while accelerating innovation velocity.
Partner across ASBX and Amazon to align execution with strategy and orchestrate shared solutions.
Influence strategy and technical direction at the most senior levels of the company through clear written narrative and data; briefs at CEO-level reviews.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent work experience.
10+ years of software development experience, including architecting fault-tolerant, highly available systems at scale.
5+ years managing people, with 3+ years managing multiple managers or teams.
Experience developing long-term technical vision and strategy and influencing leadership decisions.
Experience delivering large-scale, customer-facing products on scalable architecture.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's or PhD in Computer Science or Engineering, with 10+ years of relevant experience.
A leadership position on a team delivering solutions at Amazon or industry scale.
Proven track record of hiring world-class talent and developing engineering leaders.
Excellent written and verbal communication.
Deep experience in SRE, DevOps, incident management, or operational excellence at high scale.
Experience building or leading agentic/AI-driven operations platforms, balancing speed and safety in regulated environments.

added.title: Director of Software Engineering, Platform Services
added.description:
Credit Acceptance is proud to be an award-winning company recognized both locally and nationally across multiple workplace categories. Our world-class culture is shaped by dedicated team members who are driven to succeed as professionals individually and together as a team. Backed by a strong product, exceptional people, and a stable financial foundation, we’ve grown into a leading provider of used and new car financing across the country.

Our Engineering and Analytics Team Members utilize the latest technology to develop, monitor, and maintain complex practices that help optimize our success. Our Team Members value being challenged, are encouraged to express their ideas, and have the flexibility to enjoy work life balance. We build intrinsic value by partnering with all functions of our business to support their success and make strategic business decisions. We focus on professional development and continuous improvement while enjoying a casual work environment and Great Place to Work culture!

The Director of Software Engineering, Platform Services will help to modernize the engineering organization at Credit Acceptance by building and leading teams that deliver two sets of capabilities: the tooling, templates and standards that engineers use to build software, and the shared engineering services that multiple parts of the organization depend on, including internal products such as payments, notifications, consent and document intelligence. This role will be responsible for consolidating services that are used by multiple parts of the organization into a single place, eliminating duplication and modernizing the technology.

Credit Acceptance is adopting AI-assisted and specification-driven development across its engineering organization, and this role will lead that work. It includes the software development lifecycle and the tooling that supports it, the development environments engineers work in, the AI coding assistants and agent development frameworks they use, the golden path templates and reference implementations that make recommended practices the default, and the measurement of whether these investments are improving engineering productivity.

The ideal candidate is someone who can build and lead a platform engineering team to create the foundational tooling and services for Credit Acceptance’s scaling while also creating process and structure for the company’s growth. They should create a team culture of amplifying scale and creating strong advocates within the product verticals. They should have experience leading a high-performance horizontal engineering team, identifying what the company needs and achieving outcomes that push the company forward and accelerate engineering velocity and productivity. Equally important is a track record of delivering internal developer tooling and shared services as products, with the adoption and operational ownership that comes with them.

Outcomes and Activities:

This position will work from home; occasional planned travel to an assigned Southfield, Michigan office location may be required. However, this position is permitted to work at a Southfield, Michigan office location if requested by the team member.
Provide the strategy, leadership and day-to-day management of the Platform Services organization.
Lead the team in developing, enhancing, and supporting a set of integrated platform services for Credit Acceptance engineering teams to leverage in releasing high quality software to its customers.
Define the company’s approach to AI-assisted and specification-driven development, including coding assistants, agent development frameworks, and the standards and guardrails required to release their output safely.
Deliver the golden path templates, scaffolds and reference implementations that engineering teams use to start new work, including the frameworks and patterns those templates establish.
Own the development environments and inner loop tooling engineers use daily, including build and test performance and environment provisioning.
Be accountable for the availability, performance and support model of the shared services the organization operates, including service level objectives and on-call coverage for those services.
Create and manage the Platform Services experience required to quickly, reliably, efficiently, and securely deliver value to developers, and grow adoption across the product verticals so that the supported path is the default path.
Partner with the teams that operate delivery pipelines, cloud infrastructure and runtime platforms to deliver and support the capabilities this organization builds.
Establish and report the measures of engineering productivity, platform adoption and service performance, along with the progress of the organization’s projects.
Refine and deliver on a strategy that aligns platform goals to business objectives, priorities, and budgetary realities, weighing build, buy and open source options against the company’s ability to operate what is selected.
Ensure Credit Acceptance’s engineering tooling and shared services meet the company’s security, privacy and audit requirements and align with corporate goals.
Support business growth initiatives from a Platform Services point of view by aligning the technology vision with business strategy.
Build and manage diverse engineering teams capable of carrying out ambitious platform software initiatives, recruiting and developing engineering leaders and top engineering talent in the Platform Services space.
Set the direction of the team; anticipate strategic and scaling-related challenges via thoughtful planning, both from a personnel and technical standpoint, and lead organizational change in alignment with the company’s objectives.
Break down platform strategy and team asks into correct technical building blocks, mentoring the team’s technical output and keeping skills and knowledge current.
Provide continuous feedback, address underperformance, and recognize the individual strengths and contributions of team members.
Drive a results-oriented culture with a strong focus on execution, quality, and speed, and keep the quality bar high for the services other teams depend on.

Competencies:
The following items detail how you will be successful in this role.

Customer Empathy: Customer Empathy is the ability to understand the perspectives, pain points, and experiences of customers. It involves actively putting oneself in the customer’s shoes, comprehending their needs and challenges, and using that understanding to provide a better, more customer-centric experience.
Engineering Excellence: Engineering Excellence is about bringing great craftsmanship and thought leadership to deliver an outstanding product that delights customers and solves for the business. This involves the pursuit and achievement of high standards, best practices, innovation, and superior solutions.
One Team: A One Team mindset refers to a collaborative approach across the organization, where individuals work together seamlessly, without boundaries, as a single, cohesive team. Shared goals, open communication and mutual support create a sense of collective purpose. This enables teams to navigate challenges and pursue shared objectives more effectively.
Owner’s Mindset: Owner’s Mindset involves adopting a set of behaviors that reflect a sense of responsibility, accountability, strategic thinking, and a proactive approach to managing your domain. As an owner, you understand the business and your domain(s) deeply and solve for the right outcome for the domain(s) and the business.

Requirements:

BS/MS in Computer Science, engineering/technical degree, MBA preferred
10+ years of experience in highly technical roles in development or enterprise services, at large organizations or innovative startups
5+ years of supervisory, consultant or team lead experience, with demonstrated ability to manage multiple teams.
Track record of delivering internal developer tooling, developer platforms or shared engineering services that were adopted by other engineering teams.
Experience leading the adoption of AI-assisted software development at scale, including coding assistants, agentic development workflows, evaluation, and the guardrails required to release generated code.
History of owning services in production, including service level objectives, on-call rotations and incident response.
Proven ability to consolidate duplicated capabilities into a single supported platform, including the migration and decommissioning work required.
Demonstrated ability to communicate with C-Level leaders, conveying complex information in a timely and easily understood way to all levels of the organization.

Preferred:

Familiarity with agent development frameworks, model access layers or other AI platform capabilities
Background in a regulated industry, or working closely with security, audit and compliance functions
Working knowledge of the financial services industry, loan origination systems, web-based applications, and the automotive industry

Knowledge and Skills:

Working knowledge of the modern developer toolchain, including source control and code review workflows, continuous integration, containers, infrastructure as code, and developer portal or service catalog products.
Proven ability to think strategically, align technical initiatives with business objectives, and formulate a team’s technical strategy and roadmap in partnership with other teams.

Comfortable with navigating hard-to-follow (or non-existent) processes and comfortable identifying processes which aren’t working and changing them.
History of using data for decision making and providing a strong technical vision that your teams deliver against consistently.
An automation mindset that strives to reduce manual interventions wherever relevant.
Strong executive presence and ability to advance ideas and initiatives, keeping the customer and the company’s best interest in mind.

Target Compensation:

added.title: Director of Technology and AI
added.description:
Fireclay Tile is here to revolutionize the tile and design industry. By implementing an innovative digital platform paired with unmatched artisan-crafted products and client service, we've made it easier than ever to specify and purchase beautiful, sustainable tile sourced and handcrafted in the US. Our tireless commitment to innovation, transparency, and sustainability has not gone unrecognized. We aim to grow 25-35% annually and are the first tile company recognized as a B Corp for how we use Business as a Force for Good. With an innovative product, an ambitious team, and an inspiring mission, we're changing the way you think about tile. Come join the makers who support the dreamers!

Location: Northern California preferred

Team: Two developers, with capacity to build the team over time

Compensation: 160K-180K Base

The Team You'll Work With

You will report to Fireclay's VP of Technology, Dave Meagher, and partner closely with both the VP of Technology and our CEO to shape the next version of Fireclay's technology: a company that runs on AI, end to end.

You will lead a small team of developers building across Salesforce, Google Cloud, Shopify, and our Snowflake data layer. The VP of Technology owns the broader roadmap. You will own the AI rollout across every team, the hands-on engineering leadership, and the applied-AI work that turns that roadmap into durable business value.

The Challenge

Fireclay is AI-forward, and we want someone to own the AI rollout across the entire company, from the factory floor to marketing to sales.

We envision a near future where every knowledge worker at Fireclay uses AI all day long, as naturally as email. Production planners, customer service, sales reps, designers, marketers, and finance should each have AI woven into how they work, backed by systems they trust. Getting there is your job.

Fireclay Tile has always used technology to do things differently. We were early to the cloud, and over the last few years we have gone well past experimentation: we now run production AI skills, agents, and internal applications that our teams use every day.

We are a vertically integrated, employee-owned B Corp that makes beautiful, sustainable tile and helps clients carry a project from inspiration through installation. The work is real: complex product data, factories, supply chain, sales, design, customer service, showrooms, installation, finance, and thousands of decisions that need to happen well every day.

Owning AI here means owning more than tools. You will define and run the enterprise architecture, security, governance, and process controls that let AI scale safely across every team. That includes how models and agents access data, who can do what, how work is reviewed, how we audit and observe it, and how we decide what gets built, bought, scaled, or stopped.

This is not a role for an AI futurist who stays at 30,000 feet. You will be in the weeds: mapping work, finding constraints, building solutions, coaching teammates, and holding a high bar for security, quality, and measurable impact.

How We Work

We run our technology team like a software startup inside a manufacturing company. The pace is fast, the team is lean, and shipping matters more than planning decks.

In exchange, you get a lot of autonomy. You will have the room to learn the business deeply, decide where technology and AI can add value, and act on it quickly without waiting on layers of approval.

With AI, the distance between an idea and a working application is now days, not quarters. It is normal here to scope a problem with a business owner on Friday, build the application with AI over the weekend, and put it in front of real users on Monday. We want someone who finds that energizing, and who knows how to move that fast without cutting corners on security, data integrity, or review.

Our Stack

Claude, MCP, custom skills and agents, Google Cloud, Salesforce, Shopify Plus, Front, Dialpad, Slack, Hyros, HubSpot

The Opportunities You'll Have

Own the AI rollout across every Fireclay team, from production and supply chain to customer service, marketing, sales, and finance.
Partner with the VP of Technology and the CEO to define the next vision of Fireclay's technology, built on AI.
Design and run the enterprise architecture for AI: how agents, skills, and applications connect to Salesforce, Google Cloud, Shopify, and Snowflake, and how data flows between them.
Own AI security, governance, and process control: access and permissions, data privacy, human review, audit trails, observability, and clear ownership for every production workflow.
Lead, mentor, and grow Fireclay's development team, and raise the bar for how we build.
Learn Fireclay deeply, from customer journey and order flow through manufacturing, fulfillment, installation, and support, and find the real points of friction, delay, rework, and opportunity.
Build and ship AI-enabled workflows and applications quickly, often in days, that improve productivity, decision quality, customer experience, revenue, or cost.
Identify and pursue customer-facing AI opportunities that make it easier to discover, design, purchase, receive, and install Fireclay products.
Run a disciplined intake and prioritization process. Every meaningful AI investment should have a defined problem, baseline, owner, cost, expected value, success metric, security review, and scale-or-stop decision.
Make the right build-versus-buy decisions. Use external tools, partners, and emerging models where they create leverage, without creating a fragile or ungoverned stack.

What Success Looks Like Early

First 30 days: Map Fireclay's stack across Salesforce, Google Cloud, Shopify, and Snowflake, along with current AI use, developer capacity, core data flows, security posture, and highest-friction business processes. Meet the people doing the work, including in the physical operation. Ship something small and useful.
First 60 days: Present an AI rollout plan for every team, an enterprise AI architecture and governance framework, a capability assessment, and a prioritized 12-month plan. Select two or three high-value use cases with clear owners, baselines, ROI hypotheses, and delivery plans.
First 90 days: Ship at least one secure, measurable production workflow or application. Put in place an AI investment scorecard, a teammate enablement rhythm, a mentoring plan for each developer, and the technical standards required to scale responsibly.

What Success Looks Like In The First Year

You will have created visible, credible impact, not a slide deck of possibilities.

That means every team is using AI daily in its core work, backed by governed, secure systems. It means measurable cost savings, productivity gains, better decisions, faster developer throughput, or new revenue. It also means our developers have grown noticeably under your leadership, and Fireclay has a clear, shared architecture for an AI-first future.

We will care about token spend, but not in isolation. Every meaningful investment should show a clear return or a credible, measurable path to one.

About You

You are a builder. You have personally written and shipped production code, and you still want to. You use AI coding tools every day and can take an application from idea to production in days.
You thrive at startup speed. You are energized by autonomy, comfortable with ambiguity, and bias toward shipping and learning.
You have deep experience with modern AI application development: agents, MCP and tool use, automations, model selection, evaluation, retrieval, prompt and workflow design, and observability.
You have designed enterprise architecture, security, and governance for AI or data systems. You know how to give teams powerful tools while controlling access, protecting data, and keeping humans in the loop where it matters.
You have hands-on experience across a stack like ours: Salesforce, Google Cloud, Shopify, and a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake. You care more about how systems connect than about any single platform.
You are a strong mentor to junior developers. You have grown engineers early in their careers through code review, pairing, clear standards, and stretch assignments. You teach them to use AI well, to understand the business behind the ticket, and to own their work end to end. Your team gets better because you lead it.
You can lead developers while staying close enough to the work to make good technical and product decisions.
You bring conviction and humility: strong standards, direct communication, curiosity, and a willingness to change your mind when the evidence changes.

The Hiring Conversation

We want to see how you think and how you work, not just what is on your résumé.

Our VP of Technology will share a short video showing how he uses AI and how Fireclay applies it today. As part of the application, every candidate will submit a 3–5 minute Loom or screen recording showing one real way they use AI in their workflow.

Show us the problem you were solving, the tools and inputs you used, what you built or changed, how you checked the work, and the result. Bonus points if it's something you built fast. A sanitized example is welcome; do not share confidential customer, employer, or personal information. We are looking for real judgment and practical leverage, not AI theater.

Why Fireclay?

Beyond the role itself, here’s what makes Fireclay Tile a special place to work:

Our Mission: We are on a mission to do good by crafting products intentionally, collaboratively, and transparently. We are the makers, who support the dreamers.
Our Values: We live by Kindness, Honesty, Tread Lightly on the Earth, Measure Twice, Cut Once, and Ganas (Desire).
Our Commitment: We are accountable to the B Corp standards, prioritizing People and Planet alongside Profit.
Growth and Innovation: We are committed to "25-35% annual growth" and are revolutionizing the tile and design industry.
Our Culture: We foster a culture of professional development, ongoing training, and opportunities for growth.
Our Benefits: We offer a comprehensive compensation package, including medical, dental, vision, a 4% 401(k) match, PTO (non-exempt) or FTO (exempt), sick time, and other perks. Visit Fireclaybenefits.com to view details of our benefits and perks offered.

Serving as a Fireclay Tile Brand Ambassador, representing our core values including:

Kindness ○ Honesty ○ Tread Lightly on the Earth ○ Measure Twice, Cut Once ○ Ganas (Desire)

Accountable to the B Corp standards, we take care of our People and our Planet while turning a Profit.

added.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Job Purpose And Summary

Leads software product management for the Security Automation portfolio within Enterprise Information Security at CVS Health and serves as the direct peer and partner to the Lead Director, Security Automation. Together the two leaders run the portfolio: an engineering and product pairing modeled directly on how commercial software organizations operate.
Applies commercial-grade product management discipline to internally built security products. The portfolio automates and improves security operations, analysis, and management functions for the Security organization and for CVS Health colleagues, and its users are demanding professionals with day jobs — security operations analysts, GRC and audit teams, identity and infrastructure engineers, application teams, and in some cases colleagues across the enterprise. This leader owns continuous discovery with those users, translates workflow pain into a prioritized roadmap, defines the outcomes each product is accountable for, and holds the portfolio to those outcomes rather than to a delivery calendar.
Owns adoption as a first-class responsibility rather than a post-launch afterthought. Internal products fail in a specific and well-documented way: they are built on unverified assumptions, launched without enablement, mandated rather than adopted, and quietly abandoned. This role exists to prevent that. Accountable for internal go-to-market, enablement and documentation, onboarding of successive user groups, instrumented adoption and usage measurement, structured feedback channels, iteration against what the evidence shows, and the discipline to sunset or replace solutions that are not earning their place in the portfolio.
Leads and develops a team of product managers, with coaching and craft development as the primary work rather than personally owning products. Sets the standard for discovery, problem framing, requirements quality, and outcome measurement; hires and levels PMs; and creates the conditions for empowered product and engineering pairs to solve problems rather than execute specifications. Operates as a peer-level partner to engineering leadership, a credible voice to security function owners who did not ask to be automated, and a clear communicator to executive sponsors who need to understand what the investment is buying.
This role can work remotely from anywhere in the continental USA.

Primary Responsibilities

Owns product strategy, vision, and the multi-year roadmap for the Security Automation portfolio in partnership with the Lead Director, Security Automation; frames the problems worth solving, sequences investment against enterprise security priorities, and maintains a defensible, communicable position on why the portfolio is working on what it is working on and what it has deliberately chosen not to do
Leads, builds, and develops the product management team, treating the coaching and development of product managers as the core of the job rather than personally managing products; hires and levels PMs, sets the standard for product craft, runs a structured development approach, and leads by context rather than by control
Owns product discovery for the portfolio including direct, continuous contact with the security practitioners and CVS Health colleagues whose work the portfolio is meant to change; workflow and pain-point analysis, opportunity sizing, assumption testing before build, and validation that a proposed automation solves a problem the users actually have
Owns adoption and the full product lifecycle for everything the portfolio ships including internal launch and go-to-market, enablement, documentation and training, onboarding of new user groups, support and feedback channels, iteration based on real usage, and the decision to sunset or replace solutions that are not earning their keep
Defines and instruments the outcome measures for each product and for the portfolio as a whole including adoption and active-usage measures, manual-effort and cycle-time reduction, support deflection, and risk-reduction proxies; establishes baselines before delivery, reports honestly against them afterward, and treats shipped features as inputs rather than results
Owns requirements definition and the delivery partnership with engineering including problem statements, user stories and acceptance criteria, backlog health, release planning, scope and tradeoff decisions during delivery, and clear division of decision rights between product and engineering
Partners on build-versus-buy and commercial evaluation, bringing market scanning, competitive and vendor landscape analysis, requirements definition for proofs-of-concept, and total-cost-of-ownership and licensing analysis to decisions about whether a capability should be built, bought, or assembled on an existing enterprise platform
Serves as the primary product-facing voice to stakeholders and senior leadership including security function owners, Technology and Digital partners, and executive sponsors; communicates roadmap, tradeoffs, progress, and outcomes in language appropriate to each audience and secures the sponsorship the portfolio depends on
Owns the business case and financial framing for portfolio investments including benefit quantification, ROI and payback analysis, license and vendor cost modeling, and the value narrative used to defend and grow investment in the function
Establishes and matures the product management practice for the function including intake and prioritization mechanisms, discovery and requirements standards, roadmap and release communication cadence, product documentation standards, and the tooling that supports them

Required Qualifications

12+ years of experience in technology roles, including 8+ years in software product management
4+ years leading product managers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development — with demonstrated understanding that leading PMs is a different job from managing products personally
Product management experience gained in a commercial software or SaaS organization is strongly preferred; candidates from internal-platform or enterprise-IT-only backgrounds should be able to demonstrate equivalent product rigor
Demonstrated ownership of product strategy and multi-year roadmaps for a software product or portfolio, including the ability to articulate what was deliberately not built and why
Strong product discovery practice: direct user research and workflow analysis, opportunity sizing, assumption and risk testing before committing to build, and evidence-based decision making rather than requirements collection
Demonstrated ability to define, instrument, and report on outcome measures — adoption, active usage, effort and cycle-time reduction, support deflection, retention of usage over time — including establishing baselines before delivery
Track record of driving adoption of software products, with specific, quantified examples including at least one case where adoption stalled and what the candidate changed in response
Demonstrated prioritization judgment under real constraint, including examples of telling significant stakeholders no and managing the relationship afterward
Experience owning requirements definition and the delivery partnership with engineering: problem statements, user stories and acceptance criteria, backlog health, release planning, and in-flight scope and tradeoff decisions
Technical fluency sufficient to earn the trust of engineers and to participate credibly in architecture, integration, and feasibility discussions — including comfort with APIs, data models, and software delivery practice. Coding ability is not required
Experience with build-versus-buy analysis and commercial software evaluation, including vendor and market assessment and total-cost-of-ownership reasoning
Demonstrated ability to influence peers, senior stakeholders, and executives without direct authority, and to build genuine co-ownership with partner teams rather than transactional requirements relationships
Financial acumen: business case construction, benefit quantification, ROI and payback analysis, and budget and license cost management
Strong written communication — product briefs, strategy narratives, and roadmap communication that hold up without a presenter — and strong verbal communication across engineer-to-executive audiences
Experience operating in agile delivery models and with modern product and delivery tooling (e.g., Jira, product analytics, roadmap and discovery tools)

Preferred Qualifications

Experience as a product manager or product leader for developer-facing, platform, or internal-facing software products, where users must be won rather than acquired
Experience in a security, risk, compliance, or IT operations product domain, or demonstrated ability to learn a technical operational domain quickly and credibly
Experience with workflow automation, integration, or data platform products, including products whose value is measured in effort avoided rather than revenue generated
Experience with AI-enabled or agentic product management: defining human-in-the-loop experiences, evaluating model accuracy and failure modes, and setting user expectations for probabilistic systems
Experience with product-led adoption motions — self-service onboarding, in-product guidance, documentation as a product surface, and community or champion programs
Experience partnering with a peer engineering leader in a formal dual-leadership model, with clear and healthy division of decision rights
Experience managing a portfolio that mixes custom-built software, third-party commercial products, and platform-based configuration

Experience establishing or maturing a product management practice where none previously existed
Advanced degree or MBA; recognized product management or agile credentials

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

Zayo is seeking a highly strategic and technically accomplished Director, Software Engineering – Network Automation and AI Solutions
to lead the transformation of how we design, engineer, operate, and support our network infrastructure through automation, artificial intelligence, advanced analytics, and modern software engineering practices.
